messages:
sasha: quick RFC follow-up  some of the migration shims we discussed need an 'attenuation' plan. dropping a compact runbook + checklist for comments.
liam: nice term, what do you mean by attenuation here?
sasha: basically controlled degradation so a shim can reduce functionality instead of failing hard. think graceful API field removal, prefixed warnings, and client-tolerant fallbacks.
maya: love that. can we enumerate the mech like header flags, per-tenant opt-ins, and response-level hints?
sasha: yep. current checklist draft: 1) Ownership: who ships, who operates. 2) Telemetry: mandatory events (compat.attenuate.install, .decision, .revert) 3) Guardrails: error_pct, p50/p95 latency deltas, output divergence checks 4) Canary tests: smoke prompts + token/score diff 5) Kill-switch: global + tenant-level toggle 6) Header contract: `X-RW-Attenuate: true|probe|off` 7) CI tests: header passthrough, shim labels 8) Ops script: instant failover and audit log dump.
anna: for telemetry, suggest naming: compat.attenuate.{shim_name}.{event} and include tags: tenant_id, shim_version, model_id.
zayd: ops will want a separate alert channel for attenuation triggers. add `#attenuation-alerts` webhook and a PagerDuty routing key.
liam: what about client libraries? do we add optimistic client-side attenuation to avoid round trips?
sasha: default to server-side. allow client opt-in via the header so advanced SDKs can skip the shim if they know how to handle the new response shape.
maya: add health-check probes that run every 5m and compare golden-output token counts. failure threshold: >3% token diff OR dropped fields in JSON -> mark shim degraded.
anna: I'd add a semantic-drift check for structured outputs: run a minimal schema validation + sample asserts. If schema mismatch >0.5% of samples, trigger auto-revert.
zayd: ops note: make sure CDN/edge doesn't cache attenuation headers. add `Cache-Control: private, no-store` on shim responses when toggle active.
liam: CI test: spin up mini env with edge proxy -> service. send request with `X-RW-Attenuate: probe` and assert header arrives at service and response contains `X-RW-Attenuate-Applied: shim_v1`.
sasha: small config snippet for the UI toggle: ```json
{"attenuate_toggle": "shim_reduce_fields_v1", "rollback": {"error_pct": 1.0, "p95_latency_ms_delta": 100, "divergence_pct": 3.0}, "window_minutes": 15}```
maya: please make the divergence metric configurable per-shim; some shims are lossy by design.
sasha: agreed. per-shim policy allowed. also adding `required_telemetry=true` to prevent accidental launch.
anna: who takes what? I can own the smoke harness and schema drift checks.
sasha: I'll own the RFC appendix and UI toggle.
liam: infra CI tests I'll add and wire the header passthrough verification.
maya: dashboards and alert queries I'll draft.
zayd: ops placement + failover script on me; will add runbook to runbooks repo.
deploy-bot: queued compat-attenuation-suite (#422)  ETA 9m
sasha: cool. final ask: everyone add a one-line compatibility note to their PRs referencing the RFC section `attenuation-checklist` so we can search easily. leaving this thread open for 18h for extra feedback. :eyes:
